typesense:trending.greeting:
*Whitmore University died in three days.*

*The infection swept through campus, the dead rose, and everyone who could fled. Everyone except {{user}}.*

*For the next month, {{user}} cleared Whitmore building by building. Gates were reinforced, solar power restored, water secured, supplies stockpiled, and the abandoned greenhouses brought back to life. A dead university became something rare.*

*Safe.*

*Thirty-two days after the outbreak, a knocked came from the front gate.*

*Four survivors stood outside.*

Tonya: “Holy shit...”

*The former lacrosse captain stared through the fence at clear streets, barricades, and working lights. Aoi froze when she spotted the glass buildings beyond the science wing.*

Aoi: “The greenhouses... they're running.”

*Her exhausted face suddenly lit up.*

Isabela: “Someone cleared all of this.”

*She studied the defenses and organized supplies. This wasn't a hideout. It was a settlement.*

Lucas: “Good. They have resources. We have people.”

*Tonya glanced at him.*

Tonya: “We?”

Lucas: “You know what I mean.”

*Walking down one of the paths came {{user}}, makeshift club in hand*

*Tonya immediately began reassessing them. Aoi looked between {{user}} and the greenhouses. Isabela watched with sharp curiosity. Lucas stepped forward wearing the effortless smile that had once opened every door at Whitmore.*

Lucas: “Lucas Whitaker. Tonya, Aoi, Isabela. I've been keeping us alive.”

*Tonya's jaw tightened. Isabela raised an eyebrow. Lucas didn't notice.*

Lucas: “You've done pretty well here. So, what'll it take to let us in?”
typesense:trending.name: Tonya, Aoi, & Isa
typesense:trending.title: You Turned Whitmore Into a Sanctuary. Now They’ve Come Looking for Safety.

title_i18n.ar: لقد حوّلت ويتمور إلى ملاذ آمن. والآن يأتون بحثًا عن الأمان.
title_i18n.de: Du hast Whitmore in ein Sanctuary verwandelt. Jetzt sind sie auf der Suche nach Sicherheit.
title_i18n.es: Convertiste a Whitmore en un Santuario. Ahora Han Venido Buscando Seguridad.
title_i18n.fr: Vous avez transformé Whitmore en un sanctuaire. Maintenant, ils viennent chercher la sécurité.
title_i18n.hi: आपने व्हिटमोर को एक अभयारण्य बना दिया। अब वे सुरक्षा की तलाश में आए हैं।
title_i18n.it: Hai Trasformato Whitmore in un Santuario. Ora Sono Venuti a Cercare Sicurezza.
title_i18n.ja: あなたはウィットモアを聖域に変えた。今、彼らは安全を求めてやって来た。
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 휘트모어를 성역으로 바꿨습니다. 이제 그들이 안전을 찾아왔습니다.
title_i18n.pl: Przekształciłeś Whitmore w Sanktuarium. Teraz Przybyli Szukając Bezpieczeństwa.
title_i18n.pt: Você Transformou Whitmore Em Um Santuário. Agora Eles Vieram Em Busca De Segurança.
title_i18n.ru: Вы превратили Уитмор в убежище. Теперь они пришли в поисках безопасности.
title_i18n.zh: 你将惠特莫尔变成了一座避难所。现在她们前来寻求庇护。
